entries.title: 1979 24 Hours of Le Mans
entries.summary: The 1979 Le Mans 24 Hours was won by the #41 Kremer Racing Porsche 935 K3, driven by Klaus Ludwig and brothers Don and Bill Whittington. Porsche 935s filled the first three places.
entries.tags: 1979 24 Hours of Le Mans winner Porsche Kremer Racing 935 K3 Ludwig Whittington Le Mans endurance race
entries.license: Original short summary; source link for checking.

entries.title: 2000 24 Hours of Le Mans
entries.summary: Audi claimed its first Le Mans overall victory in 2000. The #8 Audi R8 of Frank Biela, Tom Kristensen and Emanuele Pirro won, followed by two other Audi R8s for an Audi podium sweep.
entries.tags: 2000 24 Hours of Le Mans winner Audi R8 Biela Kristensen Pirro Joest
entries.license: Original short summary; source link for checking.

entries.title: 24 Hours of Le Mans
entries.summary: Le Mans is a 24-hour endurance motor race held at the Circuit de la Sarthe in France. Teams share driving duties and aim to cover the greatest distance within the race time.

entries.title: GT3 racing
entries.summary: GT3 is a popular international class of grand touring race cars developed from production-car models. Technical regulations and Balance of Performance help different manufacturers race competitively.

entries.title: Brake fade

entries.title: Gear ratio
entries.summary: Gear ratios trade rotational speed for wheel torque. A shorter overall ratio increases engine speed for a given road speed, while a taller ratio reduces engine speed and wheel torque at that speed.
